description: "On the shared /data neurico host, API keys may be absent; GPUs are shared/contended; vLLM recipe, cached models, and pitfalls (pkill self-kill, cudnn clash, prompt_logprobs OOM)"

---

Observed 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-16 in neurico research workspaces on this host:
- OPENROUTER_KEY / OPENAI keys were NOT set in the session env (`~/.flamebird/neurico/.env` has it commented out). Resource-finder stage may be skipped (no papers/, datasets/, code/).
- Local models + datasets cached in `/data/transformers/hub` (HF_HOME=/data/transformers): Qwen2.5-{0.5,1.5,3,7,14}B-Instruct safetensors, Qwen3/3.5 family, Llama-3.1-8B, GGUFs; datasets incl. glue(sst2 only), stanfordnlp/sst2, samsum, ag_news, boolq, mmlu. huggingface.co is reachable for extra downloads (curl resolve/main URLs).
- 2026-10-16: 4x RTX A6000 (48GB) present but shared — other users' jobs held ~42GB on 3 GPUs and intermittently grabbed the 4th. Approach that worked: vLLM 0.31 (`uv add "vllm>=0.10"`; unpinned `uv add vllm` resolved an ancient 0.4 build), small `gpu_memory_utilization` (~0.11 ≈ 5GB) for ≤1.5B models on the leftover slices, plus a bash wrapper that polls `nvidia-smi` free memory and retries launch. vLLM checks free mem ≥ util×total at startup.
- 2026-10-14 (no GPU then): llama.cpp multi-server CPU fallback worked; `transformers` CPU generation much slower.
- Pitfalls: `pkill -f <pattern>` inside a Bash call whose text contains the pattern kills the calling shell (find PIDs, kill by PID separately). Leftover `nvidia-cudnn-cu12` 8.x from a failed install breaks flashinfer ("Found 2 libcudnn.so.x") — `uv pip uninstall nvidia-cudnn-cu12`. vLLM `prompt_logprobs` materialises full-vocab logits → OOM on small slices; cap `max_num_batched_tokens` (~1024). Don't edit a bash script while a running loop is executing it.
- Label-restricted log-probs in vLLM: `logprobs_mode="processed_logprobs"` + `allowed_token_ids=label_ids` returns log-softmax renormalised over the labels.

Update 2026-10-16 (inter-model-agreement workspace): 4×A6000 present but shared — other neurico sessions keep each GPU at ~6–10 GB free, fluctuating second to second. What worked:
- `uv venv --python 3.12` (default 3.14 breaks vLLM); pyproject needs `requires-python="==3.12.*"` and `[tool.uv] package=false`.
- vLLM 0.31: no bitsandbytes; set `VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0` (JIT build fails); `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`.
- Use pre-quantized 4-bit AWQ/GPTQ checkpoints (~5.5 GB for 8B): Qwen/*-AWQ, hugging-quants Llama-3.1/gemma-2 AWQ-INT4, tiiuae/Falcon3-7B-Instruct-AWQ, solidrust Mistral AWQ, kaitchup Olmo-3/Phi-3 GPTQ.
- Cap gpu_memory_utilization to ~12.5 GB and retry on startup OOM via a scheduler loop; max_model_len 2560, max_num_seqs 64.
- Gated models in /data/transformers/hub (meta-llama Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, google/gemma-7b-it) have weights but no config/tokenizer → unusable; unsloth mirror of Llama-3.1 is complete. Disk /data is ~100% full.

Update 2026-10-16 (few-shot-ordering workspace, 2nd session): a "Begin research execution" prompt can land on a workspace where a prior session already finished most work (REPORT.md exists, background jobs killed at session end). Check logs/*.status and REPORT first and resume only the interrupted pieces rather than restarting. Monitor `tail -n0 -F` on status files missed an append; poll status files directly instead. - Don't call `torch.cuda.mem_get_info()` in the vLLM parent — its CUDA context eats ~0.8 GB on GPU0 and startup then fails the free-memory check; get total via nvidia-smi.
- GPUs 0/1 top out at exactly 5125 MiB free (other users' 43 GB jobs) → budget ≤4.4 GB per slice. Multi-GPU TP rarely gets simultaneous slices; a queue with alternative configs ("1:9.5,2:4.4") was what worked. TP shards must keep quant groups aligned (Qwen2.5-3B intermediate 11008/4 not divisible by 128).
- HF `device_map` sharding needs `accelerate` installed (not pulled in by vllm).
- Self-kill again: `pkill -f`/`grep '[x]pat'` still matches if the SAME command line also contains the pattern elsewhere (e.g. a later nohup). Kill by PID in a separate call.
- Contended-GPU timings: 7–8B bf16 on a 20 GB slice ~2–8 min/level for 1.6k prompts once GPU2 freed (~17:00–19:00); Phi-3 (KV-heavy) on 13 GB of a 100%-util GPU took 33 min.

Update 2026-10-21 (cot_verbosity_threshold workspace): GPUs saturated all session (≤6 GB free, 7–8B AWQ at 8 GB never started in 40+ tries). The user's own long-lived `vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --port 8011` (cascade venv, GPU3) was idle and usable via `/v1/completions` (raw prompt + stop strings; `stop_reason` returned) — check `curl 127.0.0.1:8011/v1/models` and `/metrics` num_requests_running before using; it gave the only 7B+ model and an LLM judge. For multi-round generation against a server, run each item's rounds in its own thread (synchronous batch rounds stall on stragglers: 4 min/round → 13 min total). New vLLM startup failure on contended GPUs: "Error in memory profiling … other processes release GPU memory" — just retry. HotpotQA distractor prompts reach ~2.4k tokens; use max_model_len ≥4096.

Update 2026-10-21 (context_window_decay workspace, long-context 1K–16K prompts):
- GPUs saturated again from ~13:00 (other neurico sessions + liuxiao TP job); GPU0/1 "5125 MiB free" is another job's fluctuating activation memory — launches there fail even when the check passes. A single scheduler (one launch per GPU per 120 s) beats per-job wait loops, which raced each other (4 OOMs at once when GPU2 briefly freed 29 GB).
- Startup-race fix that worked: in run_model.py, allocate a placeholder `torch.empty(budget+0.5 GB)` immediately, release it when the vLLM EngineCore child maps `libcuda.so` (poll /proc/<child>/maps every 50 ms). Guard with an env flag (HOLD_PARENT) — vLLM spawns EngineCore by re-importing __main__, so the hold code otherwise runs again in the child. Scheduler threshold: budget + 1.3 GB.
- 16K-token prompts: Qwen2.5-7B-AWQ on a busy shared GPU ≈3k tok/s → 2,880 prompts (18M tokens) took 1h40; budget runs by total prompt tokens. 0.5–1.5B on an idle slice: 5–15 min.

Update 2026-10-21 (cot_verbosity_tax workspace, 6+ concurrent neurico sessions): GPUs were ~fully oversubscribed; launches failed ~80% from free-memory races. Lessons:
- Long multi-round generation (budget forcing, 12 rounds × up to 2k tokens) on a 100%-util shared GPU is very slow: 7B-AWQ forced arm took ~4 h incl. a ~60 min final answer pass (small KV → ~15 concurrent long contexts). Budget for it, or cut rounds/items for ≥7B.
- My own jobs on the same GPU slow each other badly — don't stack 7B+14B+alt runs on one GPU.
- Two of my queues polling independently launched on the same GPU in the same second and both failed: use ONE queue. - **Retry engine creation in-process** (poll nvidia-smi, size budget = min(max, free−0.35), retry LLM() after failures) instead of relaunching; build prompts AFTER engine init to shrink the race window.

"""Generate answers for every (item, temperature) with vLLM.

Usage: python src/generate.py <hf_model_id> <tag> <gpu_mem_gb>

Temperature grid: T=0 is greedy (1 sample); every T>0 draws N_SAMPLES i.i.d.
samples (pure temperature sampling: top_p=1, top_k=-1) with a per-request seed.
Output: results/gen/<tag>.jsonl, one line per (item, temperature).
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

os.environ.setdefault("HF_HOME", "/data/transformers")
os.environ.setdefault("HF_HUB_OFFLINE", "1")
os.environ.setdefault("VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER", "0")

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
TEMPS = [float(t) for t in os.environ.get("TEMPS", "0,0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9,1.0,1.2,1.5").split(",")]
N_SAMPLES = 10
SEED = 1234

QA_SYSTEM = ("Answer the question with a short factual answer (a few words, no explanation). "
             "If you do not know the answer, reply exactly: I don't know.")
GSM_SYSTEM = ("Solve the math word problem. Think step by step, then finish with a final line "
              "of the form 'The answer is N' where N is a number.")


def messages(item):
    sys_prompt = GSM_SYSTEM if item["task"] == "gsm8k" else QA_SYSTEM
    q = item["question"] if item["task"] == "gsm8k" else f"Question: {item['question']}\nAnswer:"
    return [{"role": "system", "content": sys_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": q}]


def gpu_total_gb():
    out = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=memory.total", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
                                   "-i", os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "0").split(",")[0]])
    return float(out.decode().strip()) / 1024


_HOLD = []
_PATCHED = []


def hold_gpu_memory(mem_gb):
    """Shared-GPU startup-race fix: wait until the (single visible) GPU has room, grab the budget at once
    with a placeholder tensor, and release it only when vLLM takes its memory snapshot. Requires the
    in-process engine (VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0) so the patch and the tensor live in one process."""
    os.environ["VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING"] = "0"
    fixed = os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")
    torch = None
    while True:
        if fixed is None:  # pick any GPU with room, then pin to it before CUDA initialises
            out = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=index,memory.free",
                                           "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"]).decode().split("\n")
            free_by = {int(a): float(b) / 1024 for a, b in (l.split(",") for l in out if l.strip())}
            gpu, free = max(free_by.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])
        else:
            gpu = int(fixed)
            free = float(subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=memory.free",
                                                  "--format=csv,noheader,nounits", "-i", fixed]).decode()) / 1024
        if free >= mem_gb + 0.6:
            if torch is None:
                os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = str(gpu)
                import torch
                fixed = str(gpu)  # stay on this GPU from now on
            try:
                _HOLD.append(torch.empty(int(mem_gb * 2**30), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"))
                break
            except torch.OutOfMemoryError:
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
        time.sleep(3)
    print(f"holding {mem_gb} GB on GPU {os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']}", flush=True)
    if _PATCHED:
        return
    _PATCHED.append(True)
    import vllm.utils.mem_utils as mu
    import vllm.v1.worker.gpu_worker as gw
    Orig = mu.MemorySnapshot

    class HeldSnapshot(Orig):
        def __post_init__(self):
            if _HOLD:
                _HOLD.clear()
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
            super().__post_init__()
    gw.MemorySnapshot = HeldSnapshot
    mu.MemorySnapshot = HeldSnapshot


def main():
    model_id, tag, mem_gb = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], float(sys.argv[3])
    out_path = f"{ROOT}/results/gen/{tag}.jsonl"
    if os.path.exists(out_path):
        print("exists, skipping", out_path)
        return
    if os.environ.get("HOLD") == "1":
        hold_gpu_memory(mem_gb)
    from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams

    util = mem_gb / gpu_total_gb()
    llm = None
    for attempt in range(30):  # shared GPUs: retry engine creation in-process
        try:
            small = mem_gb < 8  # small shared-GPU slice: eager mode, small batches
            llm = LLM(model=model_id, gpu_memory_utilization=util, max_model_len=2048,
                      max_num_seqs=48 if small else 128, max_num_batched_tokens=1024 if small else 4096,
                      seed=SEED, enforce_eager=small, enable_prefix_caching=True)
            break
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            print(f"[{tag}] engine init failed ({attempt}): {e}", flush=True)
            time.sleep(30)
            if os.environ.get("HOLD") == "1":
                hold_gpu_memory(mem_gb)  # re-acquire the slice on the same GPU before retrying
    assert llm is not None, "could not start engine"
    tok = llm.get_tokenizer()

    items = [json.loads(l) for l in open(f"{ROOT}/datasets/processed/eval_items.jsonl")]
    prompts, params, keys = [], [], []
    for k, it in enumerate(items):
        p = tok.apply_chat_template(messages(it), tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
        max_tok = 512 if it["task"] == "gsm8k" else 48
        for j, T in enumerate(TEMPS):
            if T == 0:
                sp = SamplingParams(temperature=0.0, n=1, max_tokens=max_tok)
            else:
                sp = SamplingParams(temperature=T, top_p=1.0, top_k=-1, n=N_SAMPLES, max_tokens=max_tok,
                                    seed=SEED + 1000 * k + j)
            prompts.append(p); params.append(sp); keys.append((it["id"], it["task"], T))
    print(f"[{tag}] {len(prompts)} requests", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    outs = llm.generate(prompts, params, use_tqdm=True)
    print(f"[{tag}] generation took {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
    tmp = out_path + ".partial"
    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
        for (iid, task, T), o in zip(keys, outs):
            f.write(json.dumps({"id": iid, "task": task, "temp": T, "model": tag,
                                "texts": [c.text for c in o.outputs],
                                "finish": [c.finish_reason for c in o.outputs]}) + "\n")
    os.replace(tmp, out_path)
    print(f"[{tag}] wrote {out_path}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Greedy generation for every item under several batch-size conditions, all in ONE vLLM engine.

Usage: python src/generate.py <hf_model_id> <tag> <gpu_mem_gb> [dtype]

A condition is (name, batch size B, prompt order, item subset). For each condition the item list
is put in the given order and submitted to the engine in static chunks of B prompts
(llm.generate(chunk)), so at most B sequences are ever co-scheduled; B=1 is fully sequential.
Using one engine for all conditions removes engine-initialisation as a confound; prefix caching is
disabled so every condition recomputes every prompt from scratch.

Output: results/gen/<tag>/<cond>.jsonl, one line per item with output text, token ids, and the
per-token top-1 log-prob plus top1-top2 log-prob margin (used to explain where divergences occur).
Existing condition files are skipped, so the script is resumable.
"""
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time

os.environ.setdefault("HF_HOME", "/data/transformers")
os.environ.setdefault("HF_HUB_OFFLINE", "1")
os.environ.setdefault("VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER", "0")

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SEED = 1234
MAX_NUM_SEQS = 64

# (name, B, order seed, subset rule). Ordered cheap-first so partial runs are still useful.
CONDITIONS = [
    ("b64", 64, 0, "all"),
    ("b64_rep", 64, 0, "all"),     # identical schedule again -> run-to-run noise floor
    ("b64_shuf", 64, 1, "all"),    # same B, different batch-mates
    ("b16", 16, 0, "all"),
    ("b4", 4, 0, "all"),
    ("b1", 1, 0, "all"),           # sequential reference
    ("b1_rep", 1, 0, "sub"),       # determinism check of the reference itself (every 5th item)
]

SYSTEM = {
    "gsm8k": "Solve the math word problem. Think step by step, then finish with a final line of the form "
             "'The answer is N' where N is a number.",
    "mmlu_cot": "Answer the multiple-choice question. Think step by step, then finish with a final line of "
                "the form 'The answer is X' where X is one of A, B, C, D.",
    "mmlu_direct": "Answer the multiple-choice question with only the letter (A, B, C, or D) of the correct "
                   "option. Do not explain.",
    "agnews": "Classify the news article into one of these topics: World, Sports, Business, Sci/Tech. "
              "Reply with only the topic name.",
    "sst2": "Classify the sentiment of the movie review sentence as positive or negative. "
            "Reply with only one word: positive or negative.",
}
MAX_TOKENS = {"gsm8k": 512, "mmlu_cot": 512, "mmlu_direct": 8, "agnews": 8, "sst2": 8}


def messages(it):
    return [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM[it["task"]]}, {"role": "user", "content": it["question"]}]


def gpu_total_gb():
    out = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=memory.total", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
                                   "-i", os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "0").split(",")[0]])
    return float(out.decode().strip()) / 1024


_HOLD, _PATCHED = [], []


def hold_gpu_memory(mem_gb):
    """Shared-GPU startup-race fix (see neurico notes): wait until a GPU has room, grab the budget with a
    placeholder tensor, and free it only when vLLM takes its memory snapshot (in-process engine)."""
    os.environ["VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING"] = "0"
    fixed = os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")
    torch = None
    while True:
        out = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=index,memory.free",
                                       "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"]).decode().split("\n")
        free_by = {int(a): float(b) / 1024 for a, b in (l.split(",") for l in out if l.strip())}
        if fixed is None:
            gpu, free = max(free_by.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])
        else:
            gpu, free = int(fixed), free_by[int(fixed)]
        if free >= mem_gb + 0.6:
            if torch is None:
                os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = str(gpu)
                import torch
                fixed = str(gpu)
            try:
                _HOLD.append(torch.empty(int(mem_gb * 2**30), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"))
                break
            except torch.OutOfMemoryError:
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
        time.sleep(3)
    print(f"holding {mem_gb} GB on GPU {os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']}", flush=True)
    if _PATCHED:
        return
    _PATCHED.append(True)
    import vllm.utils.mem_utils as mu
    import vllm.v1.worker.gpu_worker as gw
    Orig = mu.MemorySnapshot

    class HeldSnapshot(Orig):
        def __post_init__(self):
            if _HOLD:
                _HOLD.clear()
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
            super().__post_init__()
    gw.MemorySnapshot = HeldSnapshot
    mu.MemorySnapshot = HeldSnapshot


def order_items(items, seed, subset):
    idx = list(range(len(items)))
    random.Random(seed).shuffle(idx)  # task-mixed batches, as in a real serving queue
    if subset == "sub":
        idx = [i for i in idx if i % 5 == 0]
    return idx


def summarize(o):
    c = o.outputs[0]
    lp, margin = [], []
    for tid, d in zip(c.token_ids, c.logprobs or []):
        vals = sorted((x.logprob for x in d.values()), reverse=True)
        lp.append(round(d[tid].logprob, 5))
        margin.append(round(vals[0] - vals[1], 5) if len(vals) > 1 else None)
    return {"text": c.text, "token_ids": list(c.token_ids), "lp": lp, "margin": margin,
            "finish": c.finish_reason, "n_prompt": len(o.prompt_token_ids)}


def main():
    model_id, tag, mem_gb = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], float(sys.argv[3])
    dtype = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else "auto"
    conds = CONDITIONS
    if os.environ.get("CONDS"):
        conds = [c for c in CONDITIONS if c[0] in os.environ["CONDS"].split(",")]
    out_dir = f"{ROOT}/results/gen/{tag}"
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    todo = [c for c in conds if not os.path.exists(f"{out_dir}/{c[0]}.jsonl")]
    if not todo:
        print(f"[{tag}] all conditions done")
        return
    if os.environ.get("HOLD", "1") == "1":
        hold_gpu_memory(mem_gb)
    from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams

    util = mem_gb / gpu_total_gb()
    llm = None
    for attempt in range(40):
        try:
            llm = LLM(model=model_id, dtype=dtype, gpu_memory_utilization=util, max_model_len=2048,
                      max_num_seqs=MAX_NUM_SEQS, max_num_batched_tokens=1024, seed=SEED,
                      enforce_eager=True, enable_prefix_caching=False, max_logprobs=2)
            break
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            print(f"[{tag}] engine init failed ({attempt}): {e}", flush=True)
            time.sleep(20)
            if os.environ.get("HOLD", "1") == "1":
                hold_gpu_memory(mem_gb)
    assert llm is not None, "could not start engine"
    tok = llm.get_tokenizer()

    items = [json.loads(l) for l in open(f"{ROOT}/datasets/processed/items.jsonl")]
    if os.environ.get("LIMIT"):  # smoke tests
        items = items[::len(items) // int(os.environ["LIMIT"])]
    prompts = [tok.apply_chat_template(messages(it), tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) for it in items]
    params = [SamplingParams(temperature=0.0, max_tokens=MAX_TOKENS[it["task"]], logprobs=2) for it in items]
    meta = {"model": model_id, "tag": tag, "dtype": dtype, "mem_gb": mem_gb,
            "gpu": os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"), "max_num_seqs": MAX_NUM_SEQS}
    json.dump(meta, open(f"{out_dir}/meta.json", "w"), indent=1)

    for name, B, seed, subset in todo:
        idx = order_items(items, seed, subset)
        t0 = time.time()
        recs = []
        for s in range(0, len(idx), B):
            chunk = idx[s:s + B]
            outs = llm.generate([prompts[i] for i in chunk], [params[i] for i in chunk], use_tqdm=False)
            for pos, (i, o) in enumerate(zip(chunk, outs)):
                r = summarize(o)
                r.update({"id": items[i]["id"], "task": items[i]["task"], "batch_idx": s // B, "pos": pos})
                recs.append(r)
            if s // B % max(1, 200 // B) == 0:
                print(f"[{tag}] {name}: {s + len(chunk)}/{len(idx)} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)", flush=True)
        tmp = f"{out_dir}/{name}.jsonl.partial"
        with open(tmp, "w") as f:
            for r in recs:
                f.write(json.dumps(r) + "\n")
        os.replace(tmp, f"{out_dir}/{name}.jsonl")
        print(f"[{tag}] {name} done in {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
        with open(f"{out_dir}/timing.jsonl", "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps({"cond": name, "B": B, "n": len(idx), "sec": time.time() - t0}) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

os.environ.setdefault("HF_HUB_OFFLINE", "1")
os.environ.setdefault("VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER", "0")

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SEED = 1234
MAX_NUM_SEQS = 64

# (name, B, order seed, subset rule). Ordered cheap-first so partial runs are still useful.
CONDITIONS = [
    ("b64", 64, 0, "all"),
    ("b64_rep", 64, 0, "all"),     # identical schedule again -> run-to-run noise floor
    ("b64_shuf", 64, 1, "all"),    # same B, different batch-mates
    ("b16", 16, 0, "all"),
    ("b4", 4, 0, "all"),
    ("b1", 1, 0, "all"),           # sequential reference
    ("b1_rep", 1, 0, "sub"),       # determinism check of the reference itself (every 5th item)
]

SYSTEM = {
    "gsm8k": "Solve the math word problem. Think step by step, then finish with a final line of the form "
             "'The answer is N' where N is a number.",
    "mmlu_cot": "Answer the multiple-choice question. Think step by step, then finish with a final line of "
                "the form 'The answer is X' where X is one of A, B, C, D.",
    "mmlu_direct": "Answer the multiple-choice question with only the letter (A, B, C, or D) of the correct "

    "agnews": "Classify the news article into one of these topics: World, Sports, Business, Sci/Tech. "

    return [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM[it["task"]]}, {"role": "user", "content": it["question"]}]


def gpu_total_gb():
    out = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=memory.total", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",

    conds = CONDITIONS

    llm = None
    for attempt in range(40):

    if os.environ.get("LIMIT"):  # smoke tests
        items = items[::len(items) // int(os.environ["LIMIT"])]
    prompts = [tok.apply_chat_template(messages(it), tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) for it in items]
    params = [SamplingParams(temperature=0.0, max_tokens=MAX_TOKENS[it["task"]], logprobs=2) for it in items]
    meta = {"model": model_id, "tag": tag, "dtype": dtype, "mem_gb": mem_gb,
            "gpu": os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"), "max_num_seqs": MAX_NUM_SEQS}
    json.dump(meta, open(f"{out_dir}/meta.json", "w"), indent=1)

    for name, B, seed, subset in todo:
        idx = order_items(items, seed, subset)
        t0 = time.time()
        recs = []
        for s in range(0, len(idx), B):
            chunk = idx[s:s + B]
            outs = llm.generate([prompts[i] for i in chunk], [params[i] for i in chunk], use_tqdm=False)
            for pos, (i, o) in enumerate(zip(chunk, outs)):
                r = summarize(o)
                r.update({"id": items[i]["id"], "task": items[i]["task"], "batch_idx": s // B, "pos": pos})
                recs.append(r)
            if s // B % max(1, 200 // B) == 0:
                print(f"[{tag}] {name}: {s + len(chunk)}/{len(idx)} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)", flush=True)
        tmp = f"{out_dir}/{name}.jsonl.partial"
        with open(tmp, "w") as f:
            for r in recs:
                f.write(json.dumps(r) + "\n")
        os.replace(tmp, f"{out_dir}/{name}.jsonl")
        print(f"[{tag}] {name} done in {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
        with open(f"{out_dir}/timing.jsonl", "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps({"cond": name, "B": B, "n": len(idx), "sec": time.time() - t0}) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Planning: Batch Size Effects on LLM Greedy Inference

## Motivation & Novelty Assessment

### Why This Research Matters
Evaluation pipelines and production serving almost always batch requests, and practitioners routinely
assume that `temperature=0` makes outputs a deterministic function of the prompt. If the batch a
request lands in changes its greedy output, then benchmark numbers, regression tests, cached-answer
systems, and "reproducible" evaluations become irreproducible in ways that are invisible to the user.
How much this matters (how often, for which tasks, by how much accuracy) decides whether
batch-invariant kernels are worth their throughput cost.

### Gap in Existing Work
No resource-finder output was available in this workspace (no `papers/`, `datasets/`, `code/`), so this
review is from background knowledge. The problem is widely known: Thinking Machines Lab's "Defeating
Nondeterminism in LLM Inference" (He et al., 2025) traces it to batch-dependent reduction orders in
matmul, RMSNorm and attention kernels and proposes batch-invariant kernels. Yuan et al. (2025),
"Give Me FP32 or Give Me Death?", report accuracy swings of up to several points for reasoning models
across GPU count, batch size and dtype. Atil et al. (2024) document non-determinism of
"deterministic" API settings. What is missing is a **controlled, per-prompt** decomposition on open
models that (a) separates batch size from batch *composition* and from run-to-run noise, (b) separates
task type from output length (both vary together in most studies), (c) explains *where* in a sequence a
divergence starts (logit near-ties), and (d) compares model sizes on a single numeric format.

### Our Novel Contribution
We run byte-identical prompts through a single vLLM engine per model under static batch sizes
B ∈ {1, 4, 16, 64}, plus a same-B reshuffle and same-schedule repeats. We measure exact-match rate,
first-divergence position, the reference model's top-1/top-2 logit margin at the divergence token,

"""Score generations and analyse batch-size-induced divergence.

Reads results/gen/<model>/<cond>.jsonl (from generate.py) and writes
  results/pairs.csv          one row per (model, comparison, item): exact match, first divergence, flips
  results/accuracy.csv       accuracy per model x condition x task
  results/summary_*.csv      aggregate tables used in REPORT.md
  results/stats.json         hypothesis tests
  figures/*.png
"""
import json
import os
import re
from collections import defaultdict

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
GEN = f"{ROOT}/results/gen"
FIG = f"{ROOT}/figures"
os.makedirs(FIG, exist_ok=True)

MODELS = {  # tag -> (label, params in B, dtype)
    "q05": ("Qwen2.5-0.5B", 0.5, "bf16"), "q15": ("Qwen2.5-1.5B", 1.5, "bf16"),
    "q3": ("Qwen2.5-3B", 3.1, "bf16"), "q7": ("Qwen2.5-7B", 7.6, "bf16"),
    "l1b": ("Llama-3.2-1B", 1.2, "bf16"), "l3b": ("Llama-3.2-3B", 3.2, "bf16"),
    "q05f32": ("Qwen2.5-0.5B fp32", 0.5, "fp32"),
}
TASKS = ["gsm8k", "mmlu_cot", "mmlu_direct", "agnews", "sst2"]
LONG = {"gsm8k", "mmlu_cot"}
# (comparison name, condition a, condition b); a is the reference whose margins are used
COMPS = [("b1 vs b4", "b1", "b4"), ("b1 vs b16", "b1", "b16"), ("b1 vs b64", "b1", "b64"),
         ("b1 vs b1_rep", "b1", "b1_rep"), ("b64 vs b64_rep", "b64", "b64_rep"),
         ("b64 vs b64_shuf", "b64", "b64_shuf"), ("b4 vs b16", "b4", "b16"), ("b16 vs b64", "b16", "b64")]
BS = {"b1": 1, "b4": 4, "b16": 16, "b64": 64}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- answer extraction / scoring
def extract(task, text):
    t = text.strip()
    if task == "gsm8k":
        m = re.findall(r"answer is[:\s]*\$?\s*(-?[\d,]*\.?\d+)", t, flags=re.I)
        if not m:
            m = re.findall(r"-?[\d,]*\.?\d+", t)
        if not m:
            return None
        try:
            v = float(m[-1].replace(",", ""))
            return str(int(v)) if v == int(v) else str(v)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    if task == "mmlu_cot":
        m = re.findall(r"answer is[:\s]*\(?\**([ABCD])\b", t, flags=re.I)
        if m:
            return m[-1].upper()
        m = re.findall(r"\b([ABCD])[\.\)]", t)
        return m[-1] if m else None
    if task == "mmlu_direct":
        m = re.match(r"\W*\(?([ABCD])\b", t)
        return m.group(1) if m else None
    if task == "agnews":
        low = t.lower()
        for key, lab in [("sci", "Sci/Tech"), ("tech", "Sci/Tech"), ("science", "Sci/Tech"),
                         ("sport", "Sports"), ("business", "Business"), ("world", "World")]:
            if low.startswith(key) or re.match(rf"\W*{key}", low):
                return lab
        return None
    if task == "sst2":
        low = t.lower()
        return "positive" if "positive" in low else ("negative" if "negative" in low else None)


def correct(task, pred, gold):
    if pred is None:
        return False
    if task == "gsm8k":
        try:
            return abs(float(pred) - float(gold)) < 1e-6
        except ValueError:
            return False
    return pred == gold


def wilson(k, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0:
        return (np.nan, np.nan)
    p = k / n
    d = 1 + z * z / n
    c = (p + z * z / (2 * n)) / d
    h = z * np.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z * z / (4 * n * n)) / d
    return (c - h, c + h)


def first_div(a, b):
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(a, b)):
        if x != y:
            return i
    return None if len(a) == len(b) else min(len(a), len(b))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load
def load():
    items = {json.loads(l)["id"]: json.loads(l) for l in open(f"{ROOT}/datasets/processed/items.jsonl")}
    data = {}
    for tag in sorted(os.listdir(GEN)):
        conds = {}
        for f in os.listdir(f"{GEN}/{tag}"):
            if f.endswith(".jsonl") and f != "timing.jsonl":
                recs = {}
                for l in open(f"{GEN}/{tag}/{f}"):
                    r = json.loads(l)
                    it = items[r["id"]]
                    r["pred"] = extract(it["task"], r["text"])
                    r["correct"] = correct(it["task"], r["pred"], it["gold"])
                    recs[r["id"]] = r
                conds[f[:-6]] = recs
        if conds:
            data[tag] = conds
    return items, data


def build_pairs(items, data):
    rows = []
    for tag, conds in data.items():
        for name, ca, cb in COMPS:
            if ca not in conds or cb not in conds:
                continue
            A, Bc = conds[ca], conds[cb]
            for iid in A.keys() & Bc.keys():
                a, b = A[iid], Bc[iid]
                d = first_div(a["token_ids"], b["token_ids"])
                ma = a["margin"][d] if d is not None and d < len(a["margin"]) else np.nan
                rows.append({
                    "model": tag, "comp": name, "id": iid, "task": a["task"],
                    "len_ref": len(a["token_ids"]), "len_other": len(b["token_ids"]),
                    "exact": d is None, "div_pos": d, "margin_at_div": ma,
                    "rel_div_pos": d / len(a["token_ids"]) if d is not None and len(a["token_ids"]) else np.nan,
                    "answer_same": a["pred"] == b["pred"], "correct_ref": a["correct"], "correct_other": b["correct"],
                    "min_margin_ref": float(np.nanmin([m for m in a["margin"] if m is not None]))
                    if any(m is not None for m in a["margin"]) else np.nan,
                    "n_ties_ref": int(sum(1 for m in a["margin"] if m == 0)),
                    "finish_ref": a["finish"], "finish_other": b["finish"],
                })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_acc(items, data):
    rows = []
    for tag, conds in data.items():
        for c, recs in conds.items():
            for iid, r in recs.items():
                rows.append({"model": tag, "cond": c, "id": iid, "task": r["task"], "correct": r["correct"],
                             "parsed": r["pred"] is not None, "len": len(r["token_ids"])})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def prop_table(df, by):
    g = df.groupby(by)
    out = g.agg(n=("exact", "size"), exact=("exact", "mean"), answer_same=("answer_same", "mean")).reset_index()
    out["diverge_pct"] = 100 * (1 - out["exact"])
    ci = [wilson(int(round((1 - e) * n)), n) for e, n in zip(out["exact"], out["n"])]
    out["div_lo"] = [100 * c[0] for c in ci]
    out["div_hi"] = [100 * c[1] for c in ci]
    out["answer_change_pct"] = 100 * (1 - out["answer_same"])
    return out


def main():
    items, data = load()
    pairs = build_pairs(items, data)
    acc = build_acc(items, data)
    pairs.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/pairs.csv", index=False)
    acc.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/accuracy_items.csv", index=False)
    st = {}
    lab = lambda t: MODELS.get(t, (t,))[0]  # noqa: E731

    # ---- 1. divergence by model x comparison (all tasks / long / short)
    pairs["kind"] = np.where(pairs["task"].isin(LONG), "long (CoT)", "short (label)")
    t1 = prop_table(pairs, ["model", "comp"])
    t1k = prop_table(pairs, ["model", "comp", "kind"])
    t1t = prop_table(pairs, ["model", "comp", "task"])
    t1.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_divergence.csv", index=False)
    t1k.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_divergence_kind.csv", index=False)
    t1t.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_divergence_task.csv", index=False)

    # ---- 2. accuracy per model x cond x task, and McNemar b1 vs bX
    acc_t = acc.groupby(["model", "cond", "task"]).correct.mean().unstack("task") * 100
    acc_t["macro"] = acc_t[[t for t in TASKS if t in acc_t]].mean(axis=1)
    acc_t["micro"] = acc.groupby(["model", "cond"]).correct.mean() * 100
    acc_t.round(2).to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_accuracy.csv")
    mc = []
    for tag in data:
        for cb in ["b4", "b16", "b64", "b64_rep", "b64_shuf"]:
            sub = pairs[(pairs.model == tag) & (pairs.comp.isin([f"b1 vs {cb}"]))]
            if cb in ("b64_rep", "b64_shuf"):
                sub = pairs[(pairs.model == tag) & (pairs.comp == f"b64 vs {cb}")]
            if sub.empty:
                continue
            for scope, s in [("all", sub)] + [(t, sub[sub.task == t]) for t in TASKS]:
                n01 = int(((s.correct_ref) & (~s.correct_other)).sum())  # ref right, other wrong
                n10 = int(((~s.correct_ref) & (s.correct_other)).sum())
                p = stats.binomtest(n01, n01 + n10, 0.5).pvalue if n01 + n10 > 0 else 1.0
                # paired bootstrap CI for accuracy difference (other - ref)
                diff = s.correct_other.astype(int).values - s.correct_ref.astype(int).values
                rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
                boots = [diff[rng.integers(0, len(diff), len(diff))].mean() for _ in range(2000)] if len(diff) else [0]
                mc.append({"model": tag, "comparison": sub.comp.iloc[0], "scope": scope, "n": len(s),
                           "acc_ref": 100 * s.correct_ref.mean(), "acc_other": 100 * s.correct_other.mean(),
                           "delta_pp": 100 * diff.mean() if len(diff) else 0,
                           "ci_lo": 100 * np.percentile(boots, 2.5), "ci_hi": 100 * np.percentile(boots, 97.5),
                           "flips_right_to_wrong": n01, "flips_wrong_to_right": n10,
                           "flip_pct": 100 * (n01 + n10) / max(len(s), 1), "mcnemar_p": p})
    mc = pd.DataFrame(mc)
    # Holm correction over the main family (scope=all, b1 vs b4/b16/b64)
    fam = mc[(mc.scope == "all") & mc.comparison.str.startswith("b1 vs")].index
    if len(fam):
        ps = mc.loc[fam, "mcnemar_p"].values
        order = np.argsort(ps)
        adj = np.empty_like(ps)
        running = 0
        for rank, i in enumerate(order):
            running = max(running, min(1, ps[i] * (len(ps) - rank)))
            adj[i] = running
        mc.loc[fam, "p_holm"] = adj
    mc.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_accuracy_flips.csv", index=False)

    # ---- 3. length / task analysis: logistic regression on long tasks, b1 vs b64
    import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
    main_c = pairs[pairs.comp == "b1 vs b64"].copy()
    main_c["div"] = (~main_c.exact).astype(int)
    main_c["loglen"] = np.log(main_c.len_ref.clip(lower=1))
    try:
        lr = smf.logit("div ~ loglen + C(task, Treatment('mmlu_cot')) + C(model)",
                       data=main_c[main_c.task.isin(LONG)]).fit(disp=0)
        st["logit_long_tasks"] = {k: {"coef": float(lr.params[k]), "p": float(lr.pvalues[k])} for k in lr.params.index}
        lr2 = smf.logit("div ~ loglen + C(kind) + C(model)", data=main_c).fit(disp=0)
        st["logit_all_tasks"] = {k: {"coef": float(lr2.params[k]), "p": float(lr2.pvalues[k])} for k in lr2.params.index}
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        st["logit_error"] = str(e)

    # per-token hazard: divergences / tokens generated identically before divergence (or to the end)
    def hazard(df):
        at_risk = np.where(df.exact, df[["len_ref", "len_other"]].min(axis=1), df.div_pos.fillna(0) + 1).sum()
        return 1000 * (~df.exact).sum() / max(at_risk, 1)
    hz = main_c.groupby(["model", "task"]).apply(hazard, include_groups=False).rename("div_per_1k_tokens").reset_index()
    hz.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_hazard.csv", index=False)

    # ---- 4. mechanism: margin at divergence vs all reference tokens
    mech = []
    for tag, conds in data.items():
        if "b1" not in conds:
            continue
        allm = np.array([m for r in conds["b1"].values() for m in r["margin"] if m is not None])
        dv = main_c[(main_c.model == tag) & (~main_c.exact)].margin_at_div.dropna().values
        mech.append({"model": tag, "frac_tokens_tie": float((allm == 0).mean()),
                     "frac_tokens_margin_le_0.125": float((allm <= 0.125 + 1e-9).mean()),
                     "n_div": len(dv), "frac_div_at_tie": float((dv == 0).mean()) if len(dv) else np.nan,
                     "frac_div_margin_le_0.125": float((dv <= 0.125 + 1e-9).mean()) if len(dv) else np.nan,
                     "median_div_margin": float(np.median(dv)) if len(dv) else np.nan,
                     "max_div_margin": float(dv.max()) if len(dv) else np.nan})
    mech = pd.DataFrame(mech)
    mech.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_mechanism.csv", index=False)

    # ---- 5. size: Spearman of divergence vs params (bf16 models, b1 vs b64, long tasks)
    sz = prop_table(main_c[main_c.task.isin(LONG)], ["model"])
    sz = sz[sz.model.map(lambda t: MODELS.get(t, ("", 0, ""))[2] == "bf16")]
    sz["params"] = sz.model.map(lambda t: MODELS[t][1])
    if len(sz) >= 3:
        rho, p = stats.spearmanr(sz.params, sz.diverge_pct)
        st["size_spearman_long"] = {"rho": float(rho), "p": float(p), "n_models": len(sz)}
    # tie-propensity vs size
    st["mechanism"] = mech.to_dict(orient="records")
    json.dump(st, open(f"{ROOT}/results/stats.json", "w"), indent=1, default=float)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- figures
    order = [m for m in MODELS if m in data]
    colors = dict(zip(order, plt.cm.tab10.colors))

    # F1: divergence % vs batch size (vs b1) per model, long and short
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4), sharey=False)
    for ax, kind in zip(axs, ["long (CoT)", "short (label)"]):
        for m in order:
            s = t1k[(t1k.model == m) & (t1k.kind == kind) & t1k.comp.isin(["b1 vs b4", "b1 vs b16", "b1 vs b64"])]
            if s.empty:
                continue
            x = [BS[c.split(" vs ")[1]] for c in s.comp]
            o = np.argsort(x)
            ax.errorbar(np.array(x)[o], s.diverge_pct.values[o],
                        yerr=[s.diverge_pct.values[o] - s.div_lo.values[o], s.div_hi.values[o] - s.diverge_pct.values[o]],
                        marker="o", capsize=3, label=lab(m), color=colors[m])
            fl = t1k[(t1k.model == m) & (t1k.kind == kind) & (t1k.comp == "b1 vs b1_rep")]
            if not fl.empty:
                ax.scatter([1], fl.diverge_pct, marker="x", color=colors[m])
        ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
        ax.set_xticks([1, 4, 16, 64]); ax.set_xticklabels(["1 (rep)", "4", "16", "64"])
        ax.set_xlabel("batch size B (compared with B=1)"); ax.set_ylabel("% prompts with non-identical output")
        ax.set_title(f"{kind} tasks"); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
    axs[0].legend(fontsize=8)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/divergence_vs_batch.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F2: divergence by task (b1 vs b64) per model
    s = t1t[t1t.comp == "b1 vs b64"]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
    w = 0.8 / max(len(order), 1)
    for k, m in enumerate(order):
        r = s[s.model == m].set_index("task").reindex(TASKS)
        ax.bar(np.arange(len(TASKS)) + k * w, r.diverge_pct, w, color=colors[m], label=lab(m),
               yerr=[r.diverge_pct - r.div_lo, r.div_hi - r.diverge_pct], capsize=2)
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(TASKS)) + w * (len(order) - 1) / 2); ax.set_xticklabels(TASKS)
    ax.set_ylabel("% prompts diverging (B=1 vs B=64)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.3)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/divergence_by_task.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F3: survival of identical prefix (long tasks, b1 vs b64): P(still identical after t tokens)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4))
    for m in order:
        s = main_c[(main_c.model == m) & main_c.task.isin(LONG)]
        if s.empty:

        T = np.arange(0, 513, 4)
        dpos = s.div_pos.fillna(1e9).values
        surv = [(dpos > t).mean() for t in T]
        ax.plot(T, surv, label=lab(m), color=colors[m])
    ax.set_xlabel("generated token position t"); ax.set_ylabel("P(outputs identical through t)")
    ax.set_title("Long CoT tasks, B=1 vs B=64"); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/survival_identical_prefix.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F4: divergence rate vs output length bins (long tasks)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4))
    bins = [0, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 400, 513]
    for m in order:
        s = main_c[(main_c.model == m) & main_c.task.isin(LONG)].copy()
        if s.empty:
            continue
        s["bin"] = pd.cut(s.len_ref, bins)
        g = s.groupby("bin", observed=True).exact.agg(["mean", "size"])
        g = g[g["size"] >= 10]
        ax.plot([b.mid for b in g.index], 100 * (1 - g["mean"]), marker="o", label=lab(m), color=colors[m])
    ax.set_xlabel("reference (B=1) output length, tokens"); ax.set_ylabel("% diverging (B=1 vs B=64)")
    ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/divergence_vs_length.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F5: margin histogram at divergence vs all tokens
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4))
    edges = np.array([-0.01, 0.01, 0.13, 0.26, 0.51, 1.01, 2.01, 100])
    names = ["0 (tie)", "≤0.125", "≤0.25", "≤0.5", "≤1", "≤2", ">2"]
    allm = np.array([m for t in order if t in data and "b1" in data[t] and MODELS[t][2] == "bf16"
                     for r in data[t]["b1"].values() for m in r["margin"] if m is not None])
    dv = main_c[(~main_c.exact) & main_c.model.map(lambda t: MODELS.get(t, ("", 0, ""))[2] == "bf16")].margin_at_div.dropna().values

    x = np.arange(len(names))
    ax.bar(x - 0.2, 100 * h1, 0.4, label=f"all B=1 tokens (n={len(allm):,})", color="#999")
    ax.bar(x + 0.2, 100 * h2, 0.4, label=f"first-divergence tokens (n={len(dv):,})", color="#c44")
    ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(names)
    ax.set_xlabel("top-1 minus top-2 log-prob in B=1 run"); ax.set_ylabel("% of tokens"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)

    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/margin_at_divergence.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F6: accuracy deltas (bX - b1) with bootstrap CI, scope=all

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
    comps = ["b1 vs b4", "b1 vs b16", "b1 vs b64", "b64 vs b64_rep", "b64 vs b64_shuf"]

        ax.errorbar(np.arange(len(comps)) + (k - len(order) / 2) * 0.08, r.delta_pp,
                    yerr=[r.delta_pp - r.ci_lo, r.ci_hi - r.delta_pp], fmt="o", capsize=2, color=colors[m], label=lab(m))
    ax.axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8); ax.set_xticks(range(len(comps))); ax.set_xticklabels(comps, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("accuracy change (pp), all 1,700 items"); ax.legend(fontsize=7); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/accuracy_delta.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # ---- console summary
    pd.set_option("display.width", 200)
    print(t1.pivot(index="model", columns="comp", values="diverge_pct").round(1))
    print(t1k[t1k.comp == "b1 vs b64"][["model", "kind", "n", "diverge_pct", "div_lo", "div_hi", "answer_change_pct"]].round(1))
    print(acc_t.round(1))
    print(mc[mc.scope == "all"].round(3).to_string())
    print(mech.round(4).to_string())

toolu_01GHMQTj1q2CNpYGBUvjzXks.content:
"""Score generations and analyse batch-size-induced divergence.

Reads results/gen/<model>/<cond>.jsonl (from generate.py) and writes
  results/pairs.csv          one row per (model, comparison, item): exact match, first divergence, flips
  results/accuracy.csv       accuracy per model x condition x task
  results/summary_*.csv      aggregate tables used in REPORT.md
  results/stats.json         hypothesis tests
  figures/*.png
"""
import json
import os
import re
from collections import defaultdict

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
GEN = f"{ROOT}/results/gen"
FIG = f"{ROOT}/figures"
os.makedirs(FIG, exist_ok=True)

MODELS = {  # tag -> (label, params in B, dtype)
    "q05": ("Qwen2.5-0.5B", 0.5, "bf16"), "q15": ("Qwen2.5-1.5B", 1.5, "bf16"),
    "q3": ("Qwen2.5-3B", 3.1, "bf16"), "q7": ("Qwen2.5-7B", 7.6, "bf16"),
    "l1b": ("Llama-3.2-1B", 1.2, "bf16"), "l3b": ("Llama-3.2-3B", 3.2, "bf16"),
    "q05f32": ("Qwen2.5-0.5B fp32", 0.5, "fp32"),
}
TASKS = ["gsm8k", "mmlu_cot", "mmlu_direct", "agnews", "sst2"]
LONG = {"gsm8k", "mmlu_cot"}
# (comparison name, condition a, condition b); a is the reference whose margins are used
COMPS = [("b1 vs b4", "b1", "b4"), ("b1 vs b16", "b1", "b16"), ("b1 vs b64", "b1", "b64"),
         ("b1 vs b1_rep", "b1", "b1_rep"), ("b64 vs b64_rep", "b64", "b64_rep"),
         ("b64 vs b64_shuf", "b64", "b64_shuf"), ("b4 vs b16", "b4", "b16"), ("b16 vs b64", "b16", "b64")]
BS = {"b1": 1, "b4": 4, "b16": 16, "b64": 64}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- answer extraction / scoring
def extract(task, text):
    t = text.strip()
    if task == "gsm8k":
        m = re.findall(r"answer is[:\s]*\$?\s*(-?[\d,]*\.?\d+)", t, flags=re.I)
        if not m:
            m = re.findall(r"-?[\d,]*\.?\d+", t)
        if not m:
            return None
        try:
            v = float(m[-1].replace(",", ""))
            return str(int(v)) if v == int(v) else str(v)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    if task == "mmlu_cot":
        m = re.findall(r"answer is[:\s]*\(?\**([ABCD])\b", t, flags=re.I)
        if m:
            return m[-1].upper()
        m = re.findall(r"\b([ABCD])[\.\)]", t)
        return m[-1] if m else None
    if task == "mmlu_direct":
        m = re.match(r"\W*\(?([ABCD])\b", t)
        return m.group(1) if m else None
    if task == "agnews":
        low = t.lower()
        for key, lab in [("sci", "Sci/Tech"), ("tech", "Sci/Tech"), ("science", "Sci/Tech"),
                         ("sport", "Sports"), ("business", "Business"), ("world", "World")]:
            if low.startswith(key) or re.match(rf"\W*{key}", low):
                return lab
        return None
    if task == "sst2":
        low = t.lower()
        return "positive" if "positive" in low else ("negative" if "negative" in low else None)


def correct(task, pred, gold):
    if pred is None:
        return False
    if task == "gsm8k":
        try:
            return abs(float(pred) - float(gold)) < 1e-6
        except ValueError:
            return False
    return pred == gold


def wilson(k, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0:
        return (np.nan, np.nan)
    p = k / n
    d = 1 + z * z / n
    c = (p + z * z / (2 * n)) / d
    h = z * np.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z * z / (4 * n * n)) / d
    return (c - h, c + h)


def first_div(a, b):
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(a, b)):
        if x != y:
            return i
    return None if len(a) == len(b) else min(len(a), len(b))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load
def load():
    items = {json.loads(l)["id"]: json.loads(l) for l in open(f"{ROOT}/datasets/processed/items.jsonl")}
    data = {}
    for tag in sorted(os.listdir(GEN)):
        conds = {}
        for f in os.listdir(f"{GEN}/{tag}"):
            if f.endswith(".jsonl") and f != "timing.jsonl":
                recs = {}
                for l in open(f"{GEN}/{tag}/{f}"):
                    r = json.loads(l)
                    it = items[r["id"]]
                    r["pred"] = extract(it["task"], r["text"])
                    r["correct"] = correct(it["task"], r["pred"], it["gold"])
                    recs[r["id"]] = r
                conds[f[:-6]] = recs
        if conds:
            data[tag] = conds
    return items, data


def build_pairs(items, data):
    rows = []
    for tag, conds in data.items():
        for name, ca, cb in COMPS:
            if ca not in conds or cb not in conds:
                continue
            A, Bc = conds[ca], conds[cb]
            for iid in A.keys() & Bc.keys():
                a, b = A[iid], Bc[iid]
                d = first_div(a["token_ids"], b["token_ids"])
                ma = a["margin"][d] if d is not None and d < len(a["margin"]) else np.nan
                rows.append({
                    "model": tag, "comp": name, "id": iid, "task": a["task"],
                    "len_ref": len(a["token_ids"]), "len_other": len(b["token_ids"]),
                    "exact": d is None, "div_pos": d, "margin_at_div": ma,
                    "rel_div_pos": d / len(a["token_ids"]) if d is not None and len(a["token_ids"]) else np.nan,
                    "answer_same": a["pred"] == b["pred"], "correct_ref": a["correct"], "correct_other": b["correct"],
                    "min_margin_ref": float(np.nanmin([m for m in a["margin"] if m is not None]))
                    if any(m is not None for m in a["margin"]) else np.nan,
                    "n_ties_ref": int(sum(1 for m in a["margin"] if m == 0)),
                    "finish_ref": a["finish"], "finish_other": b["finish"],
                })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_acc(items, data):
    rows = []
    for tag, conds in data.items():
        for c, recs in conds.items():
            for iid, r in recs.items():
                rows.append({"model": tag, "cond": c, "id": iid, "task": r["task"], "correct": r["correct"],
                             "parsed": r["pred"] is not None, "len": len(r["token_ids"])})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def prop_table(df, by):
    g = df.groupby(by)
    out = g.agg(n=("exact", "size"), exact=("exact", "mean"), answer_same=("answer_same", "mean")).reset_index()
    out["diverge_pct"] = 100 * (1 - out["exact"])
    ci = [wilson(int(round((1 - e) * n)), n) for e, n in zip(out["exact"], out["n"])]
    out["div_lo"] = [100 * c[0] for c in ci]
    out["div_hi"] = [100 * c[1] for c in ci]
    out["answer_change_pct"] = 100 * (1 - out["answer_same"])
    return out


def main():
    items, data = load()
    pairs = build_pairs(items, data)
    acc = build_acc(items, data)
    pairs.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/pairs.csv", index=False)
    acc.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/accuracy_items.csv", index=False)
    st = {}
    lab = lambda t: MODELS.get(t, (t,))[0]  # noqa: E731

    # ---- 1. divergence by model x comparison (all tasks / long / short)
    pairs["kind"] = np.where(pairs["task"].isin(LONG), "long (CoT)", "short (label)")
    t1 = prop_table(pairs, ["model", "comp"])
    t1k = prop_table(pairs, ["model", "comp", "kind"])
    t1t = prop_table(pairs, ["model", "comp", "task"])
    t1.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_divergence.csv", index=False)
    t1k.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_divergence_kind.csv", index=False)
    t1t.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_divergence_task.csv", index=False)

    # ---- 2. accuracy per model x cond x task, and McNemar b1 vs bX
    acc_t = acc.groupby(["model", "cond", "task"]).correct.mean().unstack("task") * 100
    acc_t["macro"] = acc_t[[t for t in TASKS if t in acc_t]].mean(axis=1)
    acc_t["micro"] = acc.groupby(["model", "cond"]).correct.mean() * 100
    acc_t.round(2).to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_accuracy.csv")
    mc = []
    for tag in data:
        for cb in ["b4", "b16", "b64", "b64_rep", "b64_shuf"]:
            sub = pairs[(pairs.model == tag) & (pairs.comp.isin([f"b1 vs {cb}"]))]
            if cb in ("b64_rep", "b64_shuf"):
                sub = pairs[(pairs.model == tag) & (pairs.comp == f"b64 vs {cb}")]
            if sub.empty:
                continue
            for scope, s in [("all", sub)] + [(t, sub[sub.task == t]) for t in TASKS]:
                n01 = int(((s.correct_ref) & (~s.correct_other)).sum())  # ref right, other wrong
                n10 = int(((~s.correct_ref) & (s.correct_other)).sum())
                p = stats.binomtest(n01, n01 + n10, 0.5).pvalue if n01 + n10 > 0 else 1.0
                # paired bootstrap CI for accuracy difference (other - ref)
                diff = s.correct_other.astype(int).values - s.correct_ref.astype(int).values
                rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
                boots = [diff[rng.integers(0, len(diff), len(diff))].mean() for _ in range(2000)] if len(diff) else [0]
                mc.append({"model": tag, "comparison": sub.comp.iloc[0], "scope": scope, "n": len(s),
                           "acc_ref": 100 * s.correct_ref.mean(), "acc_other": 100 * s.correct_other.mean(),
                           "delta_pp": 100 * diff.mean() if len(diff) else 0,
                           "ci_lo": 100 * np.percentile(boots, 2.5), "ci_hi": 100 * np.percentile(boots, 97.5),
                           "flips_right_to_wrong": n01, "flips_wrong_to_right": n10,
                           "flip_pct": 100 * (n01 + n10) / max(len(s), 1), "mcnemar_p": p})
    mc = pd.DataFrame(mc)
    # Holm correction over the main family (scope=all, b1 vs b4/b16/b64)
    fam = mc[(mc.scope == "all") & mc.comparison.str.startswith("b1 vs")].index
    if len(fam):
        ps = mc.loc[fam, "mcnemar_p"].values
        order = np.argsort(ps)
        adj = np.empty_like(ps)
        running = 0
        for rank, i in enumerate(order):
            running = max(running, min(1, ps[i] * (len(ps) - rank)))
            adj[i] = running
        mc.loc[fam, "p_holm"] = adj
    mc.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_accuracy_flips.csv", index=False)

    # ---- 3. length / task analysis: logistic regression on long tasks, b1 vs b64
    import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
    main_c = pairs[pairs.comp == "b1 vs b64"].copy()
    main_c["div"] = (~main_c.exact).astype(int)
    main_c["loglen"] = np.log(main_c.len_ref.clip(lower=1))
    try:
        lr = smf.logit("div ~ loglen + C(task, Treatment('mmlu_cot')) + C(model)",
                       data=main_c[main_c.task.isin(LONG)]).fit(disp=0)
        st["logit_long_tasks"] = {k: {"coef": float(lr.params[k]), "p": float(lr.pvalues[k])} for k in lr.params.index}
        lr2 = smf.logit("div ~ loglen + C(kind) + C(model)", data=main_c).fit(disp=0)
        st["logit_all_tasks"] = {k: {"coef": float(lr2.params[k]), "p": float(lr2.pvalues[k])} for k in lr2.params.index}
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        st["logit_error"] = str(e)

    # per-token hazard: divergences / tokens generated identically before divergence (or to the end)
    def hazard(df):
        at_risk = np.where(df.exact, df[["len_ref", "len_other"]].min(axis=1), df.div_pos.fillna(0) + 1).sum()
        return 1000 * (~df.exact).sum() / max(at_risk, 1)
    hz = main_c.groupby(["model", "task"]).apply(hazard, include_groups=False).rename("div_per_1k_tokens").reset_index()
    hz.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_hazard.csv", index=False)

    # ---- 4. mechanism: margin at divergence vs all reference tokens
    mech = []
    for tag, conds in data.items():
        if "b1" not in conds:
            continue
        allm = np.array([m for r in conds["b1"].values() for m in r["margin"] if m is not None])
        dv = main_c[(main_c.model == tag) & (~main_c.exact)].margin_at_div.dropna().values
        mech.append({"model": tag, "frac_tokens_tie": float((allm == 0).mean()),
                     "frac_tokens_margin_le_0.125": float((allm <= 0.125 + 1e-9).mean()),
                     "n_div": len(dv), "frac_div_at_tie": float((dv == 0).mean()) if len(dv) else np.nan,
                     "frac_div_margin_le_0.125": float((dv <= 0.125 + 1e-9).mean()) if len(dv) else np.nan,
                     "median_div_margin": float(np.median(dv)) if len(dv) else np.nan,
                     "max_div_margin": float(dv.max()) if len(dv) else np.nan})
    mech = pd.DataFrame(mech)
    mech.to_csv(f"{ROOT}/results/summary_mechanism.csv", index=False)

    # ---- 5. size: Spearman of divergence vs params (bf16 models, b1 vs b64, long tasks)
    sz = prop_table(main_c[main_c.task.isin(LONG)], ["model"])
    sz = sz[sz.model.map(lambda t: MODELS.get(t, ("", 0, ""))[2] == "bf16")]
    sz["params"] = sz.model.map(lambda t: MODELS[t][1])
    if len(sz) >= 3:
        rho, p = stats.spearmanr(sz.params, sz.diverge_pct)
        st["size_spearman_long"] = {"rho": float(rho), "p": float(p), "n_models": len(sz)}
    # tie-propensity vs size
    st["mechanism"] = mech.to_dict(orient="records")
    json.dump(st, open(f"{ROOT}/results/stats.json", "w"), indent=1, default=float)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- figures
    order = [m for m in MODELS if m in data]
    colors = dict(zip(order, plt.cm.tab10.colors))

    # F1: divergence % vs batch size (vs b1) per model, long and short
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4), sharey=False)
    for ax, kind in zip(axs, ["long (CoT)", "short (label)"]):
        for m in order:
            s = t1k[(t1k.model == m) & (t1k.kind == kind) & t1k.comp.isin(["b1 vs b4", "b1 vs b16", "b1 vs b64"])]
            if s.empty:
                continue
            x = [BS[c.split(" vs ")[1]] for c in s.comp]
            o = np.argsort(x)
            ax.errorbar(np.array(x)[o], s.diverge_pct.values[o],
                        yerr=[s.diverge_pct.values[o] - s.div_lo.values[o], s.div_hi.values[o] - s.diverge_pct.values[o]],
                        marker="o", capsize=3, label=lab(m), color=colors[m])
            fl = t1k[(t1k.model == m) & (t1k.kind == kind) & (t1k.comp == "b1 vs b1_rep")]
            if not fl.empty:
                ax.scatter([1], fl.diverge_pct, marker="x", color=colors[m])
        ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
        ax.set_xticks([1, 4, 16, 64]); ax.set_xticklabels(["1 (rep)", "4", "16", "64"])
        ax.set_xlabel("batch size B (compared with B=1)"); ax.set_ylabel("% prompts with non-identical output")
        ax.set_title(f"{kind} tasks"); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
    axs[0].legend(fontsize=8)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/divergence_vs_batch.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F2: divergence by task (b1 vs b64) per model
    s = t1t[t1t.comp == "b1 vs b64"]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
    w = 0.8 / max(len(order), 1)
    for k, m in enumerate(order):
        r = s[s.model == m].set_index("task").reindex(TASKS)
        ax.bar(np.arange(len(TASKS)) + k * w, r.diverge_pct, w, color=colors[m], label=lab(m),
               yerr=[r.diverge_pct - r.div_lo, r.div_hi - r.diverge_pct], capsize=2)
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(TASKS)) + w * (len(order) - 1) / 2); ax.set_xticklabels(TASKS)
    ax.set_ylabel("% prompts diverging (B=1 vs B=64)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.3)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/divergence_by_task.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F3: survival of identical prefix (long tasks, b1 vs b64): P(still identical after t tokens)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4))
    for m in order:
        s = main_c[(main_c.model == m) & main_c.task.isin(LONG)]
        if s.empty:
            continue
        T = np.arange(0, 513, 4)
        dpos = s.div_pos.fillna(1e9).values
        surv = [(dpos > t).mean() for t in T]
        ax.plot(T, surv, label=lab(m), color=colors[m])
    ax.set_xlabel("generated token position t"); ax.set_ylabel("P(outputs identical through t)")
    ax.set_title("Long CoT tasks, B=1 vs B=64"); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/survival_identical_prefix.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F4: divergence rate vs output length bins (long tasks)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4))
    bins = [0, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 400, 513]
    for m in order:
        s = main_c[(main_c.model == m) & main_c.task.isin(LONG)].copy()
        if s.empty:
            continue
        s["bin"] = pd.cut(s.len_ref, bins)
        g = s.groupby("bin", observed=True).exact.agg(["mean", "size"])
        g = g[g["size"] >= 10]
        ax.plot([b.mid for b in g.index], 100 * (1 - g["mean"]), marker="o", label=lab(m), color=colors[m])
    ax.set_xlabel("reference (B=1) output length, tokens"); ax.set_ylabel("% diverging (B=1 vs B=64)")
    ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/divergence_vs_length.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F5: margin histogram at divergence vs all tokens
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4))
    edges = np.array([-0.01, 0.01, 0.13, 0.26, 0.51, 1.01, 2.01, 100])
    names = ["0 (tie)", "≤0.125", "≤0.25", "≤0.5", "≤1", "≤2", ">2"]
    allm = np.array([m for t in order if t in data and "b1" in data[t] and MODELS[t][2] == "bf16"
                     for r in data[t]["b1"].values() for m in r["margin"] if m is not None])
    dv = main_c[(~main_c.exact) & main_c.model.map(lambda t: MODELS.get(t, ("", 0, ""))[2] == "bf16")].margin_at_div.dropna().values
    h1 = np.histogram(allm, edges)[0] / max(len(allm), 1)
    h2 = np.histogram(dv, edges)[0] / max(len(dv), 1)
    x = np.arange(len(names))
    ax.bar(x - 0.2, 100 * h1, 0.4, label=f"all B=1 tokens (n={len(allm):,})", color="#999")
    ax.bar(x + 0.2, 100 * h2, 0.4, label=f"first-divergence tokens (n={len(dv):,})", color="#c44")
    ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(names)
    ax.set_xlabel("top-1 minus top-2 log-prob in B=1 run"); ax.set_ylabel("% of tokens"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.3)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/margin_at_divergence.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # F6: accuracy deltas (bX - b1) with bootstrap CI, scope=all
    s = mc[(mc.scope == "all")]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
    comps = ["b1 vs b4", "b1 vs b16", "b1 vs b64", "b64 vs b64_rep", "b64 vs b64_shuf"]
    for k, m in enumerate(order):
        r = s[s.model == m].set_index("comparison").reindex(comps)
        ax.errorbar(np.arange(len(comps)) + (k - len(order) / 2) * 0.08, r.delta_pp,
                    yerr=[r.delta_pp - r.ci_lo, r.ci_hi - r.delta_pp], fmt="o", capsize=2, color=colors[m], label=lab(m))
    ax.axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8); ax.set_xticks(range(len(comps))); ax.set_xticklabels(comps, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("accuracy change (pp), all 1,700 items"); ax.legend(fontsize=7); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{FIG}/accuracy_delta.png", dpi=150); plt.close()

    # ---- console summary
    pd.set_option("display.width", 200)
    print(t1.pivot(index="model", columns="comp", values="diverge_pct").round(1))
    print(t1k[t1k.comp == "b1 vs b64"][["model", "kind", "n", "diverge_pct", "div_lo", "div_hi", "answer_change_pct"]].round(1))
    print(acc_t.round(1))
    print(mc[mc.scope == "all"].round(3).to_string())
    print(mech.round(4).to_string())
    print(hz.pivot(index="model", columns="task", values="div_per_1k_tokens").round(2))
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in st.items() if k != "mechanism"}, indent=1)[:3000])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
